title: Coordinate projection formula
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $J$ be a subset of the coordinates $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, let $x$ be a function from these coordinates to $\mathbb F_2$, and let $q$ index one of the $|J|$ positions. The linear coordinate projection of $x$ onto $J$, at position $q$, is the value of $x$ at the coordinate corresponding to $q$ under the increasing enumeration of $J$.
